{{Wireless adapter |brand=TP-LINK |model=TL-WN651G |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=10/14/2005 |manuf_country=China |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |if=PCI |vendor_id=168c |device_id=0013 |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=TE7WN65XG |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Atheros |chip1_model=AR2414 |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |flags= |ant_conn=RP-SMA |802dot11_protocols=bg |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui=00:1D:0F |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This device is basically identical to the [[TP-LINK TL-WN651G]], but this device has an external antenna (via RP-SMA connector) .
The [http://madwifi-project.org/wiki/Compatibility/TP-Link MadWifi wiki references this device as having an AR5212 chipset for some versions] (< v1.4 and v1.5)... but this may not be entirely accurate. It may be that confusion arose from the PCI ID (168c:0013 is [http://www.wikidevi.wi-cat.ru/wiki/Special:Ask?title=Special%3AAsk&q=%5B%5BVendor+ID%3A%3A168c%5D%5D+%5B%5BDevice+ID%3A%3A0013%5D%5D&po=%3FFCC+ID%0D%0A%3FSubvendor+ID%0D%0A%3FSubdevice+ID%0D%0A%3FChip1+model%0D%0A%3FChip2+model%0D%0A%3FChip3+model%0D%0A%3FOUI%0D%0A&sort_num=&order_num=ASC&eq=yes&p%5Bformat%5D=broadtable&p%5Blimit%5D=500&p%5Bsort%5D=Chip1+model&p%5Boffset%5D=0&p%5Bheaders%5D=show&p%5Bmainlabel%5D=&p%5Blink%5D=all&p%5Bsearchlabel%5D=&p%5Bintro%5D=&p%5Boutro%5D=&p%5Bdefault%5D=&p%5Bclass%5D=sortable+wikitable+smwtable&eq=yes used by AR5212, AR5213, and some early AR241x devices]).
[http://forums.linuxmint.com/viewtopic.php?f=53&t=111428 PCI ID and OUI (00:1D:0F) mention] :'''<small>ath5k phy0: Atheros AR2414 chip found (MAC: 0x79, PHY: 0x45)</small>'''
